title: Addition Layer
source_docs: Deep Learning Toolbox/Deep Learning Layers/Combination Layers/Addition_Layer.md
text: Addition layer, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Data format} sets Format of input data; {Number of Inputs}, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the data type of output, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Output integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point output cast operation, {Output saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action for output cast, {Accumulator} sets the data type of accumulator, {Internal integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for internal fixed-point operations, {Internal saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action for internal block and {Sample time} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: First input data scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Second input data scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_N
ports.summary: N th input data scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Data format
params.values: Format of input data SSC (default) | C | CT | SC | SSSC

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Keep MSB | Inherit: Keep LSB | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input | Inherit: Same as accumulator |

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Output integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point output cast operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Output saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action for output cast operation off (default) | on

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Data type of accumulator Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input |

params.name: Internal integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for internal fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Internal saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action for internal block operations off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Option to specify sample time -1 (default) | scalar
